greeting: Hello, you're through to Trattoria Vecchia. I'm the AI assistant on this demo line. How can I help?
core_facts: Trattoria Vecchia: Neapolitan pizza, fresh pasta and Italian small plates, in Nottingham.
Sunday: 12 noon till 8pm. Tuesday to Saturday: lunch 12 noon till 2:30pm, dinner 5:30pm till 10pm. Closed Mondays.
Seating: inside (11 tables) and terrace (4 tables). The terrace is bookable; if the weather turns, we move you inside. Walk-ins are welcome when a table is free.
Takeaway: click and collect by phone and delivery to NG1, NG2, evenings; food takes about 20 minutes. Takeaway is paid when you collect.
Step-free entrance, level floor throughout the ground floor, and an accessible toilet. Children are very welcome, with highchairs and a kids’ menu. 3 highchairs.
No car park of our own; the nearest multi-storey is about five minutes’ walk.
hours: Sunday: 12 noon till 8pm. Tuesday to Saturday: lunch 12 noon till 2:30pm, dinner 5:30pm till 10pm. Closed Mondays.
